intent: Create an isolated OMNIS WING v0 fork-admission harness from the pinned OMNIS WING source, with a deterministic protected-workspace routing boundary that proves protected project material is refused before any CN provider call.
audience: JourdanLabs Captain, Videl as builder, and Bulma/independent gate validating whether the named OMNIS WING product can become a trustworthy host for the OMNIS project runtime.
role: a senior Python/TypeScript integration engineer building a minimally invasive, test-first host adapter without modifying any live WING installation or using provider credentials
done:
Creates a new isolated repository at ~/projects/omnis-wing, never writing to ~/.omnis-wing/omnis-wing
Records an admission manifest with product name OMNIS WING, upstream WING source URL, pinned base commit 2213ea9fa73ab06cf667c1bfb1e99c8de3541589, fork commit, and contract-protocol version
Keeps the upstream WING project runnable for its normal test target; it does not copy caches, profiles, provider credentials, sessions, or .omniskey-runtime state
Adds one small host-boundary module with an explicit action envelope containing project id, spec digest, privacy profile, source references, declared route residency, and action digest
For privacy profile protected plus a project source reference plus route residency CN, refuses before provider invocation and emits a refusal receipt with a zero-call stub-provider assertion
For a declared allowed generic action with no project source reference, invokes the injected stub provider exactly once and emits an allowed receipt
For protected work with missing source provenance, refuses before provider invocation
Adds a direct-transport/import guard appropriate to the touched host modules and proves it fails when a forbidden direct provider/https path is planted
Provides a cold local test command that exercises the allowed, protected-CN, missing-provenance, and bypass can-fail controls without network or real credentials
Writes BUILD_HANDOFF.md naming every command, observed result, base/fork commits, files changed, and what this v0 does not prove
non_goals:
Modifying, stopping, upgrading, or reconfiguring the live ~/.omnis-wing/omnis-wing instance where Videl currently runs
Calling MiniMax, Kimi, OpenAI, any live CADUCEUS router, or any external provider
Copying API keys, OAuth tokens, session data, Keychain items, memories, browser data, user profiles, or .omniskey-runtime data
Claiming full TERMINUS integration, workstation-wide protection, all plugin coverage, mobile approval, channel automation, or production readiness
Packaging, notarizing, publishing, pushing a remote branch, or replacing the existing WING executable
constraints:
The existing live WING tree is dirty and must be treated as evidence, not a build target: local changes are cli.py, tools/transcription_tools.py, package-lock.json, and untracked .omniskey-runtime
New work must be isolated under ~/projects/omnis-wing and tracked in git
Network must not be required by tests; use injected local stubs
No secret-bearing file may be read or copied
No action may rely on a filename/module/flag exemption to bypass the boundary
The protocol is a v0 local seam pending Slice 0 shared-contract extraction; do not claim it is the final cross-product SDK
Builder must run the ordinary and can-fail tests cold; gate will independently re-run them
If the pinned base cannot be acquired without touching the live tree or network, stop and report REFUSED_AS_UNSAFE rather than substituting a different source
format: An isolated OMNIS WING v0 repository with admission manifest, minimal adapter module, deterministic local tests, a test runner, no runtime provider dependency, and BUILD_HANDOFF.md. Output must bind to this CADMUS input SHA-256 and state READY_FOR_GATE, not shipped.
